title: nv-rs capabilities, version 1
description: Per built-in script extender, how many commands are implemented, how many exist, and the implemented names. Generated from the command tables; names and counts only.

version.description: The version the extender hands xNVSE (what GetPluginVersion answers for it); absent for xNVSE itself.

reported_installed.description: When the engine answers IsPluginInstalled 1 for this extender: 'always' or a condition in words (for example the data folder holds Tale of Two Wastelands).

unbuilt_commands.description: Named commands of the extender that the engine knows are called by games it reports the extender for and does not build.
